people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Rachel
people.line: Wife of Jacob; mother of Joseph and Benjamin

people.name: Rebekah
people.line: Wife of Isaac; mother of Jacob and Esau

translations.web: Jacob told Rachel that he was her father’s relative, and that he was Rebekah’s son. She ran and told her father.
translations.bsb: He told Rachel that he was Rebekah’s son, a relative of her father, and she ran and told her father.
translations.kjv: And Jacob told Rachel that he was her father's brother, and that he was Rebekah's son: and she ran and told her father.
translations.asv: And Jacob told Rachel that he was her father's brother, and that he was Rebekah's son. And she ran and told her father.
